scope: Exact source bodies; canonical SQL, signed agreement, actual owner ledger_receive commits and license synchronization. Synthetic future-period invoices and ARB transport/mode; actual adapter readback and cancellation orchestration. No real provider, credentials, production settings, HTTP or independent approval.
original_failures: The initial probe failed 2/6 on combined 640049eb. The first native fixture failed 48/236 on frozen #298 and passed 236/236 on the first correction. Expanded parent failed 57/270. The first expanded corrected fixture deliberately revoked the owner in-process; the real login redirect terminated all four lanes before JSON reporting. Original stdout/stderr and fixture copies are retained. Owner denial now runs in its own PHP process and verifies actual 303, no provider request and preserved records. No application auth behavior was weakened.
limitations: Provider transport and mode are synthetic; readback validation and SQL/ledger code are real.
Future-period invoices and initial/historical receipts are synthetic fixtures.
One separate committed PDO writer per retirement lane changes retained profile data after terminal readback.
Cancellation ambiguity never rolls back committed payment or permanent payoff.
No real gateway, installed browser, final combined upgrade/main, external approval or release claim.
Replacement enrollment function bodies remain unchanged; payoff concurrent with replacement creation requires separate audit.
